Performance language with no dates attached.

faqs.a: 11 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.
US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

bottomLine: Romolizio does what it says mechanically - signals, two modes, a broker partner. The open questions are pricing clarity and verification, both solvable by reading before funding.
Our 4.8 reflects what the pages publish and what they skip. It is not a warning off - it is a reminder to trade the product, not the pitch.
